name: Error-constrained k-d tree grid simplification
aliases: k-d tree simplification via error metrics
definition: A simplification method for k-d trees that removes minimal partitioning faces based on error metrics until a threshold is exceeded.
summary: Error-constrained k-d tree grid simplification reduces isosurface complexity by removing partitioning faces while ensuring geometric deviation stays within user-defined on, in, and out metric thresholds.
